name: Metrolínea
body: nosniff, framing limited to its origin, a working sitemap, and a 301 from http to https. But the viewport sets maximum-scale=1 and user-scalable=no, which blocks pinch-zoom for riders who need larger text.
lesson: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale. Let readers zoom, and fix any layout that breaks.
summary: www.metrolinea.gov.co scores 69 out of 100 (D). 3 checks fail now, 32 are at risk, and 13 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 20 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /v3.0/, /v3.0/quienes-somos/metrolinea, /v3.0/sala-de-prensa, /v3.0/mapa-del-sitio and 15 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 500 sitemap URLs point at another host or scheme
fix.evidence: In /sitemap.xml: metrolinea.gov.co (500). The sitemap should list only URLs on https://www.metrolinea.gov.co.
fix.fix: Regenerate the sitemap with the production https host.

fix.title: 108 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page sets a mobile viewport
